notes: v506 — two corrections to numbers that decisions were being made on, both found by measuring every formula against an independent reference. FIRST: the RSI. The maths was exactly right (Wilder's, the same as every broker chart), but the app rounded it to a whole number BEFORE testing it against thresholds, while the server tested the raw value — so every RSI band on your device was one point wider than the same band on the server, and the 🤖 don't-chase gate skipped a share at RSI 69.5 because it rounded to 70. Now every decision uses the raw value and only the DISPLAY rounds. SECOND: the volatility number that sizes every 🎯 Trade Plan parcel. It quietly threw away any day the share moved more than 60% — which made the wildest shares look calm to the one calculation whose whole job is to know they are not. Measured on a share with two such days: 10.3%/day with them discarded, 17.0% with them counted — the sizer was acknowledging 65% less risk on exactly the shares it most needed to be right about. Extreme days are now clamped and KEPT, and the small statistical bias that oversized every parcel by ~2.5% is fixed too. Parcels on wild shares get smaller. That is the correction working — the old, larger parcels were the flattering ones. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
